questions.question: Who is responsible for patching the guest operating system for Amazon RDS?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS is a managed service, so AWS (the RDS product team) patches the underlying guest operating system and database engine. With RDS the customer does NOT patch the OS — a key difference from running a database yourself on Amazon EC2.
